[[Leilon's Vow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Leilon, Tranquil Water]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Hidden City of Ahdashim]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy#Energy_regeneration_and_degeneration|Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Elegant Scythe]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Elegant Scythe]] from collectors [[Swift Fiercejustice]] or [[Jovial Pete]]
*[[Zealous]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
